reported.topic: Q2 FY27 constant currency revenue growth
reported.quote: Our revenue growth for Q2 was at 1.5% YoY and 1.2% sequentially in constant currency terms.
Q2 operating margins were at 21%, decline of 0.1% sequentially.
AI revenue was a standout at 10.5% of our revenue, growing at 29% sequentially.
We won 19 large deals in Q2 with a TCV of $5.2 bn, which is second highest quarterly TCV in the last five years.
Free cash flow was at $928 mn, representing 113% of net profit, large deal wins were at $5.2 bn with 62% net new.
The Board has announced an interim dividend of `26, an increase of 13% compared to last year.

business: Infosys provides digital transformation, enterprise AI strategy and deployment, cloud, cyber security, and legacy modernization services globally. Its operations are structured across key industry verticals including Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy Utilities Resources & Services (EURS), Retail, Communications, Life Sciences, and Hi-Tech.
